question: limits[].kind has no term for an allowance counted in a vendor unit or in requests over a period (Credits a month, requests per 5 hours), and free_tier.metered_on has no term for tokens or Credits. why: volume-quota is defined as a byte allowance, and Credit and request allowances are the main quota shape of the coding-subs topic
